subject: DesignGrid trial: prompt transfer, eval plan & success metrics
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena@designgrid.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: DesignGrid trial: prompt transfer, eval plan & success metrics

Hi Lena — thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned for the trial/POC: 

High-level objective
- Validate that Redwood inference reduces latency and cost while maintaining or improving response quality for DesignGrid’s assistant workflows (search-driven QA + template generation).

Success criteria (agreed):
- Quality: median human-rated utility >= 4.0/5 on our shared rubric; hallucination rate < 6% on sampled prompts.
- Latency: 95th pctile <= 450ms for typical 256-token requests under trial load.
- Cost: per-1k-token inference cost target <= 0.75x your current baseline (TBD after sample run).
- Ops: ability to run 2 daily eval runs and share dashboard; SLO for availability during trial: 99.5%.

Evaluation plan & deliverables
- You provide: ~2,000 representative prompts and 200 labeled golden answers (CSV), plus a 200-example validation set with human ratings where available.
- Redwood provides: eval harness, scoring scripts, dashboards (redwood-console link), and a short report summarizing model variants, quantization profile, and recommendations.
- Metric set: human utility, exact-match for structured outputs, BLEU/ROUGE for templated responses, hallucination checks, latency & token cost.

Data transfer and security
- Please remove PII before upload where possible; see attached redaction_checklist.md. If you prefer, we can provide presigned S3 uploads and perform an automated light mask step, but we will need your confirmation for Redwood to process raw logs.

Owners & timeline
- Sales (Ava): contractual/PO coordination and acceptance criteria.
- CS (Neha): prompt collection guidance and eval coordination.
- Solutions Eng (Sean): ingestion, run configuration, and dashboarding.
- Target: samples in hand by Aug 9 to start initial evaluations Aug 10–14; delivery of trial report by Aug 18.

Next steps (action items)
1) Lena: send sample CSV (first 200 prompts + any golden answers) and point of contact for procurement/IT.
2) Redwood (Neha/Sean): share presigned S3 details and eval rubric + CSV template.
3) Both: confirm whether Redwood can process raw logs or if DesignGrid will pre-mask.

Attached: designgrid_prompts_sample.csv (sample), redaction_checklist.md, eval_rubric_template.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call if you want to talk through the rubric.

— Ava
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0122

From: Lena Park <lena@designgrid.ai>

Date: 2028-07-31T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DesignGrid trial: prompt transfer, eval plan & success metrics

Thanks Ava — appreciate the clear rundown. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Procurement & security: procurement looped in (copied) — they will need SOC 2 evidence and a short data-processing addendum. Can you send the SOC 2 PDF and a standard DPA?

2) Prompt data: we can produce the 2,000 prompts but need explicit guidance on PII removal. We’ll attach a small export sample (attached) — note that original logs contain user identifiers and occasional email snippets.

3) Evaluation metrics: can you confirm whether the trial will prioritize human-rated utility over exact-match for our template generation use case? We have internal preference for human metrics but want clarity.

4) Timing: procurement is aiming to complete PO review in ~3 weeks (by Aug 21) assuming SOC2/DPA look good. From a technical side, we can try to get the sample prompts to you by Aug 9 as discussed.

Attached: export_sample_prompts.csv (sample)

Lena Park
Head of Product, DesignGrid
lena@designgrid.ai
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena@designgrid.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DesignGrid trial: prompt transfer, eval plan & success metrics

Great — high-level answers inline and resources below. Thanks for the sample, it was helpful.

1) SOC2/DPA: attaching our SOC 2 summary PDF now (also can share full report under NDA). Procurement — happy to kick off the DPA redline.

2) PII & masking guidance:
- Preferred: you pre-mask direct identifiers (emails, phone numbers, SSNs). Use xxxx placeholders or column-level redaction in CSV.
- Alternate: we can accept raw logs to perform an automated light-mask pass (hash/email->anonymized-id) before any human sees them; this requires signed DPA that allows processing.

3) Metrics prioritization: for template generation we recommend a hybrid approach: human utility is primary for go/no-go; exact-match and structured-field accuracy are secondary and useful for regression tracking. Our default eval_rubric_template.csv uses weighted scoring (60% human utility, 25% structured accuracy, 15% hallucination rate).

4) Upload mechanics:
- We will generate one-time presigned S3 upload links per file. Please upload as: s3://redwood-designgrid-trial/{team-name}/prompts/YYYYMMDD_export.csv
- File format: CSV, columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, context (optional), golden_answer (optional), label (optional). See attached template.

5) Ownership & timeline (confirming):
- DesignGrid prompt owner: Lena (for product questions) + a technical contact for S3 upload (please provide).
- Redwood: Neha (CS lead) will manage the eval runs and coordinate human ratings; Sean (SE) will do ingestion and runtime tuning.
- Timeline: Start eval runs Aug 10 with the sample and full run once we have full set (target Aug 10–14 for initial runs).

Action: We will send presigned links and a short onboarding doc (s3 upload steps, redaction checklist) by EOD tomorrow.

— Ava

- Procurement contact: procurement@designgrid.ai (they’ll send the PO once SOC 2 and DPA are received).
- On masking: we will pre-mask obvious direct identifiers (emails/phones). For conversational snippets that may contain PII, we prefer Redwood to run the automated light-mask during ingestion — please confirm the scope of that processing and where logs are stored during the eval period.

Also could you share a short NDA copy and the SOC2 summary to speed procurement? We attached a tiny sample export (export_sample_prompts.csv) in case it helps.

Look forward to the presigned links.
